status: Proposed analysis refinements with bounded accepted profile core

decisions.title: Resource-scoped operation eligibility
decisions.question: May the intended actor perform this exact protected operation?

conditions.name: Scoped authority valid
conditions.meaning: Exact actor/resource/action scope has an applicable defined grant; invitation, sign-in, another-resource membership or administrator label alone is insufficient.

conditions.name: Current state permits
conditions.meaning: Applicable account/resource/grant state permits this operation under the current reviewed policy.

conditions.name: Operation conditions met
conditions.meaning: Required current subject/revision/relationship conditions are satisfied for the intended operation.

rows.meaning: Do not perform protected operation or disclose protected content.
No positive authorization until intended scope/grant is established.
Do not use a revoked/ineligible context for the requested effect.
Reconcile current eligibility; do not assume a stale permission remains effective.
Report invalid/conflicting/ineligible request without claiming success.
Keep missing policy/evidence visible; do not infer permission.
Eligibility is established for this scope; actual execution/result still requires its own contract.

decisions.limits: Existing detailed grants/state policies remain proposed. This table does not create a complete role/action matrix, universal admin access or a persistent authorization cache.

decisions.title: Profile edit, selected apply and separate publication
decisions.question: Which requested action may affect which presentation?

conditions.name: Operation
conditions.meaning: Supported intended goal; no unsupported operation enters this table.

conditions.name: Explicit confirmation
conditions.meaning: Owner explicitly confirms this exact selected apply or separately intended publication; preview alone is not confirmation.

conditions.name: Current eligible context
conditions.meaning: Current intended scope/content is valid and eligible; this abstracts validation rather than choosing a concurrency mechanism.

rows.meaning: Source edit alone changes no existing resume draft/live presentation; actual sent content remains independent.
No requested application; keep existing resume content unchanged by source edit alone.
Do not infer consent to apply.
Do not claim eligible selected application.
Resolve intended selection/current context before claiming eligible apply.
Explicit selected apply affects intended draft only; preserve overrides/other resumes/actual history; does not publish.
Saving/applying alone does not publish.
Do not infer separate publication consent.
Do not claim eligible publication.
Resolve exact intended current publication context.
Separate confirmed eligible publication may change intended live presentation; actual history stays independent.

decisions.limits: A labels accepted preservation/explicit-action core, not acceptance of abstract validation predicates or implementation labels. Eligibility is not confirmation that a save/publish actually happened.

decisions.title: PDF mode and requested variant
decisions.question: Does the saved mode enable the requested PDF category before other checks?

conditions.name: Mode
conditions.meaning: Actual effective per-resume mode, not a pending or assumed settings save.

conditions.name: Variant
conditions.meaning: Requested PDF category; uploaded language availability is checked separately.

rows.meaning: Category is enabled only; still check intended publication/language, actual availability and protected access.
Do not expose this PDF category through this mode; do not disable page/link or substitute a private variant.
Do not expose this PDF category through this mode; do not disable page/link or substitute a private variant.
Category is enabled only; still check intended publication/language, actual availability and protected access.
Category is enabled only; still check intended publication/language, actual availability and protected access.
Category is enabled only; still check intended publication/language, actual availability and protected access.
Do not expose this PDF category through this mode; do not disable page/link or substitute a private variant.
Do not expose this PDF category through this mode; do not disable page/link or substitute a private variant.

decisions.limits: Generated/uploaded/both/neither is a scope capability; timing, stale rendition and language fallback details retain Q-D09/Q-D10 proposal status. No automatic translation or unrelated fallback is inferred.

decisions.title: Protected selected representation eligibility
decisions.question: May this exact page/evidence/PDF representation be exposed now?

conditions.name: Protected access permits
conditions.meaning: Applicable exact-link/password/current access context is valid for this request; employer viewer account is not required.

conditions.name: Representation selected
conditions.meaning: Intended published page/evidence or mode-enabled PDF is selected for this employer context; direct file reference cannot bypass selection.

conditions.name: Exact variant available
conditions.meaning: Exact requested revision/language/artifact is actually available and eligible under reviewed rendition policy.

rows.meaning: Do not expose protected content.
No positive exposure decision without established applicable access.
Do not expose unrelated/unselected content or a disabled PDF category.
Resolve intended publication/selection/mode before exposure.
Report unavailable selection/variant; no unrelated or private fallback.
Do not claim current available representation based on stale/ambiguous evidence.
Expose only permitted exact representation under current retrieval contract; actual completion is separate.

decisions.limits: Current-request eligibility is distinct from already downloaded copies. Detailed active-session/in-flight/password-change timing remains proposed; no invented duration.

decisions.title: Fresh request after confirmed link change
decisions.question: Can a fresh request obtain access through this specific link?

conditions.name: Effective enabled state
conditions.meaning: Actual current link enablement is confirmed; saving PDF mode does not change this fact.

conditions.name: Applicable credentials
conditions.meaning: Exact current request satisfies adopted password/optional-expiry/current-access policy.

rows.meaning: Fresh request cannot gain protected access via a confirmed disabled link.
Reconcile actual effective link state; do not report confirmed disablement or authorize from uncertainty.
Reject this protected access context without claiming recall of delivered copies.
Do not invent credential/session/expiry timing or permission.
Proceed to RB-D04 selection/representation checks, not unrestricted resource access.

decisions.limits: Fresh-request disablement is required scope behavior; exact session/in-flight effects remain Q-D05/Q-D11 proposals. Password changes and enable/disable are independent from PDF-mode edits.

decisions.title: Actual submitted-set completeness
decisions.question: May this recorded material set be described as complete preservation?

conditions.name: Actual identity established
conditions.meaning: Intended application/event and material actually submitted are identified; current live content is not presumed identical.

conditions.name: Required components present
conditions.meaning: All required components under the reviewed capture contract are present for this actual set.

conditions.name: Preservation confirmed
conditions.meaning: Actual required components and associations are confirmed retained in identifiable independent context.

rows.meaning: Do not substitute current source and claim actual preservation.
Retain uncertainty about actual material/event identity.
Report missing required material; progress may still be separately truthful.
Do not claim all required actual components are present.
Report definite incomplete/failed preservation with known effects.
Reconcile actual capture; do not replace uncertainty by a success claim.
Describe only this confirmed actual set as complete; later source/live edits do not overwrite it.

decisions.limits: Historical independence is accepted. Required components, provenance, corrections/resubmissions and retention remain detailed proposals. Complete actual history is not a backup or indefinite-retention guarantee.

decisions.title: Reviewed provider send eligibility
decisions.question: May the intended message/reply be submitted as a new explicit attempt?

conditions.name: Send capability valid
conditions.meaning: Intended account identity, product/resource authority and actual provider send capability are current.

conditions.name: Final review current
conditions.meaning: Explicit confirmation matches current sender/recipients/body/attachments/reply context; later changes require renewed review.

conditions.name: Attempt eligible without blind retry
conditions.meaning: No unresolved prior equivalent send effect is being blindly retried; proposed new attempt is separately eligible.

rows.meaning: No provider send action under denied/revoked/wrong-account context.
No enabled send claim; establish actual capability.
Keep unsent intent; do not reuse stale confirmation.
Do not infer final send consent from missing evidence.
Do not create blind duplicate; reconcile attributable prior effect.
Keep prior acceptance uncertainty visible before consequential resend.
May attempt exact reviewed send; classify actual provider outcome with RB-D18, never infer delivery/read.

decisions.limits: OAuth has not been created. This is conditional proposed behavior; provider acceptance is not recipient delivery/read. No deduplication or retry mechanism is selected.

decisions.title: Local calendar action versus provider mutation
decisions.question: Does this selected goal require provider capability or conflict resolution?

conditions.name: Goal
conditions.meaning: Supported requested goal; local unlink only removes association.

conditions.name: Connection
conditions.meaning: Actual intended provider identity/capability is usable.

conditions.name: Mapping/context
conditions.meaning: Relevant account/mapping/version/field-authority context is established and current.

conditions.name: Conflict
conditions.meaning: A relevant concurrent local/provider conflict is established.

rows.meaning: Use current local-operation authority/validation contract; no provider write or active connection inferred.
Use permitted local unlink contract; no provider delete or provider write capability required.
No dependent provider mutation; retained copy may remain stale.
Do not assume actual provider access.
Reconcile selected account/mapping/current context before mutation.
Do not infer current mapping/field authority.
Do not silently overwrite conflicting local/provider changes.
Assess relevant versions; unknown conflict status is not conflict-free.
Perform only exact permitted selected action; classify actual result and freshness separately.

decisions.limits: Local paths still require RB-D01/current validation; dashes ignore provider facts only. Reconnection does not make stale mappings fresh or authorize replay. Direction/time/delete/reminder policies remain proposed.

decisions.title: Subject-specific work completion
decisions.question: May this task or backlog item be described as completed/accepted?

conditions.name: Subject operation
conditions.meaning: Exact current subject and requested completion/correction are authorized and valid for its state.

conditions.name: Subject criteria
conditions.meaning: Reviewed criteria for this subject are actually satisfied; task progress alone is not backlog-item acceptance.

conditions.name: Required acceptance
conditions.meaning: Any separately required item acceptance is actually established; for a task this means its own applicable completion contract, not invented item approval.

rows.meaning: Do not force an invalid/unauthorized progress transition.
Establish exact subject/state/operation rather than inferring from board position.
Retain incomplete result under applicable subject rules.
Do not infer completion from missing criterion evidence.
Do not claim item acceptance because all tasks appear Done.
Retain current acceptance uncertainty.
Report completion/acceptance only for evaluated subject and reviewed contract.

decisions.limits: Readiness to select is a separate proposed predicate (SM-F01), not an accepted fourth To do/In progress/Done state. No counts or acceptance role are invented.

decisions.title: Sprint period end versus goal/item outcome
decisions.question: May the Sprint-end result be recorded as a concluded period?

conditions.name: End transition
conditions.meaning: Current Sprint scope/state and end/cancel operation are permitted.

conditions.name: Actual period result
conditions.meaning: Actual period/goal result is identified truthfully; this is not a predicate requiring goal achievement.

conditions.name: Work disposition
conditions.meaning: Selected items and incomplete work have explicit reviewed disposition; no silent acceptance/erasure/carryover.

rows.meaning: Do not claim invalid period transition.
Establish current permitted transition.
Do not invent achieved goal or completed work.
Keep actual goal outcome unconfirmed.
Retain incomplete disposition rather than automatic carryover.
Resolve required actual item disposition before complete end record.
May record actual permitted period conclusion even if goal was not achieved and items remain incomplete.

decisions.limits: One composite Sprint Backlog retains goal, selected items and plan. No fixed cadence, extra team member, automatic carryover or all-work-Done precondition is introduced.

decisions.title: Current revision-specific merge eligibility
decisions.question: May this exact intended integration be attempted?

conditions.name: Merge authority valid
conditions.meaning: Current repository/source/target and merge-operation authority permit intended integration.

conditions.name: Evaluated revisions current
conditions.meaning: Intended evaluated source/target revisions match the current relevant integration context.

conditions.name: Review/check policy satisfied
conditions.meaning: Applicable review/check validity, conflict conditions and reviewed merge policy are satisfied for those revisions.

rows.meaning: Do not integrate under unrelated or stale resource authority.
Do not assume merge authority.
Re-evaluate changed source/target; do not silently carry old eligibility.
Establish actual current evaluated context.
Report conflict/stale review/check or unmet policy without integration success.
No positive merge decision from missing review/check/policy evidence.
May attempt only intended integration; actual ref effect must be confirmed/reconciled separately.

decisions.limits: No merge strategy, reviewer count or solo-review exception is selected. Clone/read/push/review/merge and deployment remain distinct authorities.

decisions.title: Workflow execution admission
decisions.question: May an attributable attempt be admitted under the reviewed execution contract?

conditions.name: Definition/revision valid
conditions.meaning: Trigger, evaluated code/revision and supported workflow definition are identified and valid.

conditions.name: Execution authority valid
conditions.meaning: Current scoped execution/secret authority permits this intended attempt; unrelated repository access is insufficient.

conditions.name: Safe execution demonstrated
conditions.meaning: Suitable isolation, actual resources/limits, secret boundaries and cleanup/operational conditions are demonstrated for this attempt.

rows.meaning: No unsupported/stale-context execution.
Do not infer supported definition or evaluated code.
No execution under missing intended authority.
No enablement based on assumed permissions.
Do not enable dependent execution without required conditions.
Current demo/idle capacity does not prove safe suitable execution.
May admit attributable attempt under actual reviewed contract; admission is not start/success/output/deploy proof.

decisions.limits: Safe execution environment is not demonstrated. No isolation technology, resource number, queue, retry protocol or runner topology is chosen.

decisions.title: Separate target deployment eligibility
decisions.question: May this exact artifact/revision affect this intended target?

conditions.name: Target authority
conditions.meaning: Separate current exact-target operation/approval conditions are satisfied; merge/build/release is insufficient.

conditions.name: Artifact identity
conditions.meaning: Exact intended deployable artifact/revision is available and suitable for intended target.

conditions.name: Target conditions
conditions.meaning: Actual current target/data compatibility/recovery conditions required by reviewed deployment contract are met.

rows.meaning: No target action from inherited build/merge permission.
Do not assume target approval.
Do not deploy stale/wrong/unavailable content.
Establish intended artifact/revision before consequential action.
Do not proceed under unmet target/recovery conditions.
Do not infer safety or recovery ability from build success.
Only intended authorized target effect may be attempted; actual partial/unknown result remains separately assessed.

decisions.limits: No live deployment, universal rollback or blind retry is authorized. Existing target state must be reconciled before further consequential recovery/retry.

decisions.title: Effective file admission
decisions.question: May this exact candidate be admitted under the actual effective policy?

conditions.name: Effective policy
conditions.meaning: Exact action authority and currently effective valid policy are established; a proposed/pending save is not effective.

conditions.name: Candidate conditions
conditions.meaning: Actual candidate/content/reference and processing requirements satisfy reviewed admission rules.

conditions.name: Actual capacity
conditions.meaning: Applicable current actual usage, configured limits and concurrent-admission/resource contract permit intended growth.

rows.meaning: No admission under an invalid/unauthorized effective-policy claim.
Reconcile actual effective policy; do not use an unconfirmed new limit.
Reject candidate without destroying unrelated/protected material.
Do not claim an eligible/usable artifact from missing evidence.
Do not exceed reviewed effective allowance or silently delete history for space.
Idle free disk/two independent prechecks are not a proven concurrent-admission guarantee.
May process intended candidate; actual usable completion and any capacity reclamation need confirmation.

decisions.limits: No numeric quota/retention/resource values or accounting algorithm are invented. Policy lowering is not cleanup; failed replacement does not itself authorize deletion of prior required material.

decisions.title: Reference-aware physical reclamation eligibility
decisions.question: May this specific retained information be physically reclaimed?

conditions.name: Category policy permits
conditions.meaning: Exact resource/category reclamation authority and explicit reviewed lifecycle policy apply; archive/unlink/trash are distinct goals.

conditions.name: Retention permits removal
conditions.meaning: Applicable reviewed retention conditions actually permit reclamation now.

conditions.name: References permit removal
conditions.meaning: All affected required references/actual-submission obligations permit intended reclamation under reviewed relationship rules.

rows.meaning: Do not infer purge authority from archive, association removal or general admin label.
No invented deletion cascade, trash period or purge contract.
Do not reclaim merely due to quota pressure or a pending delete request.
Resolve applicable eligibility without inventing a duration.
Do not silently destroy protected actual history or unrelated content.
Assess actual dependent references; missing evidence is not absence of references.
Eligibility only; report freed storage/data removed only after actual required effect is confirmed.

decisions.limits: Category-specific policy is required; no universal soft delete, cascade, retention period or physical cleanup action is selected. Restore is independently authorized.

decisions.title: Scoped usable recovery assessment
decisions.question: May this isolated recovery be described as demonstrated usable recovery?

conditions.name: Source/drill scope established
conditions.meaning: Protected identified source, required material/coverage, operator authority and suitable isolated target actually exist for the authorized scenario.

conditions.name: Consistency/access checks pass
conditions.meaning: Restored candidate integrity, required relationships/artifacts, present access and external-state disposition pass defined scoped checks.

conditions.name: Measured criteria satisfied
conditions.meaning: Actual measurements and required scoped usability/target criteria are defined and satisfied for this drill.

rows.meaning: No drill/completeness claim without actual source/isolated scope.
No readiness assumption from backup existence or host capacity.
Record actual gaps/failed checks; do not reactivate old grants or replay external effects by default.
Restored bytes alone do not establish usable recovery.
Record actual missed criteria/limits, not blanket success.
No invented RPO/RTO or success without defined measured evidence.
Record demonstrated scoped usable recovery with measurements/limits; no universal guarantee or live-restore authority.

decisions.limits: Backups are not configured. No backup provider, recovery target, retention number, live overwrite or automatic rights restoration is chosen.

decisions.title: Meaningful language and historical time context
decisions.question: May the selected language/time-dependent record be interpreted as the intended value?

conditions.name: Defined semantic role
conditions.meaning: Requested manual language variant or relevant event/recorded/displayed-time role is identified under reviewed domain meaning.

conditions.name: Actual value/context
conditions.meaning: Exact intended variant/value and necessary language/time-zone/precision context are available where required by that domain operation.

conditions.name: Provenance/correction
conditions.meaning: Required original/corrected/history context remains distinguishable under applicable reviewed policy.

rows.meaning: Do not conflate manual language content or event/recorded/displayed times.
Keep missing language/time meaning explicit.
Report missing/unavailable intended value without automatic translation or unrelated fallback.
Do not guess time-zone, event order or variant identity.
Do not silently overwrite represented actual event/material meaning.
Keep uncertain correction/event context visible.
Use only established domain-specific meaning; this does not choose universal timestamp/language storage fields.

decisions.limits: Apply this template to one specific language-dependent or time-dependent decision, not a requirement for both on every record. No automatic translation, timezone value, ordering precision or storage schema is selected.

decisions.title: Truthful observed result wording
decisions.question: What may be reported from the normalized evidence disposition for this exact operation?

conditions.name: Evidence disposition
conditions.meaning: Mutually exclusive normalized outcome of evidence assessment, not raw facts presumed mutually exclusive.

rows.meaning: Report only required confirmed effect; no inferred recipient reading, universal deployment success or recovery guarantee.
Report definite failure with known effects; failure does not universally prove rollback/old subject state.
Report confirmed partial effects and remaining uncertainty; do not claim full success or full removal.
Report same operation still pending/in progress; observation end is not subject termination.
Reconcile attributable same operation; no automatic resend/restart/retry or assumption unchanged.
Report denied intended prohibited effect; do not imply a previous unknown operation was rolled back.
Do not fabricate normalized certainty; reconcile permitted authoritative evidence before consequential action.

decisions.limits: This table governs report meaning after evidence assessment, not a mechanism that derives truthful facts from arbitrary logs. Inconsistent/unsupported raw evidence stays unresolved; reporting eligibility does not grant protected evidence access.

limits: Finite-domain partition/document checks; not real predicate truth, product tests or full criterion coverage
